name: merqanta
description: Merqanta - Full-stack Autonomous Commerce CRM with Supabase PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, React Vite frontend, Resend email integration, and evidence-grounded Action Agent

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm run --prefix server dev" "npm run --prefix client dev"
scripts.build: npm run --prefix server build && npm run --prefix client build
